description: This file defines the Settings class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, managing configurations such as chart renderers, cache, locale, libxml options, and HTTP client settings used throughout the library.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A static class providing configuration management for PhpSpreadsheet, including chart renderer selection, cache handling, locale settings, libxml options, and HTTP client configuration.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale code used for formula translation and formatting.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the current locale code setting.

methods.name: setChartRenderer
methods.description: Sets the class name of the chart renderer implementation.

methods.name: getChartRenderer
methods.description: Returns the class name of the current chart renderer.

methods.name: htmlEntityFlags
methods.description: Returns the HTML entity flags used internally.

methods.name: setLibXmlLoaderOptions
methods.description: Sets options for libxml loader, deprecated.

methods.name: getLibXmlLoaderOptions
methods.description: Gets options for libxml loader, deprecated.

methods.name: setLibXmlDisableEntityLoader
methods.description: Deprecated method related to libxml entity loader.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Configures the cache implementation used for cell collection.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache implementation used for cell collection, initializes default if not set.

methods.name: useSimpleCacheVersion3
methods.description: Determines if SimpleCache version 3 should be used based on PHP version and cache interface.

methods.name: setHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client and request factory implementations.

methods.name: unsetHttpClient
methods.description: Unsets the HTTP client and request factory.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Retrieves the configured HTTP client, throws if not configured.

methods.name: getRequestFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the request factory, throws if not configured.
